reason: A web UI overlay that visualizes public A-share quote changes as an animated bull or bear, with a configurable watchlist and market race display.

summaries.zh: 将公开的A股行情变化可视化为可拖动的牛熊宠物，并提供自选列表与市场竞速面板。
summaries.en: Visualizes public A-share market changes as a draggable bull-or-bear pet with a configurable watchlist and market race panel.

capabilities: Fetches public A-share quote data from Sina Finance and stock search results from Tencent
Computes portfolio-average price changes and derives bull or bear animation state
Displays a draggable web UI overlay with a watchlist and market race visualization
Reads and writes a workspace watchlist file
Exposes quote and search operations through an RPC channel
